title: Cheap South Florida Weekend Plans
igCaption:
Start with the free plan, then work your way up.
Nov. 6-9, South Florida, free to $60

Sources: Miami New Times, CBS News, Local 10

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #MiamiWeekend #ThingsToDo

scenes.text: Here are weekend plans in South Florida that start free. Start in North Miami.

location.name: Greek Orthodox Church of the Annunciation

scenes.text: The North Miami Greek Festival runs Friday at the Greek Orthodox Church of the Annunciation on Northwest Second Avenue. Admission is free with RSVP. The church grounds turn into a Greek village with live music, traditional dancing, homemade meals, raffles, vendors, and guided church tours.

scenes.text: Subtropic Film Festival opens its fourth installment with Homegrown, a block of five short films from five directors. This year’s theme is Between Two Waters, focused on where the ocean and the Everglades meet. Tickets cost ten to thirty dollars.

scenes.text: Sunday at the Miami Beach Bandshell, Dance Now! Miami gives a preview of its 27th season. Fall for Dance Now starts at 7 p.m. and includes excerpts from the company’s Nutcracker Clara. Tickets cost ten to twenty-five dollars. If you’re at the Bandshell, check NEAR to see who else showed up.

scenes.text: Saturday at Pinecrest Gardens, the 17th annual Jazz at Pinecrest Gardens starts at 8 p.m. Singer Allyson Briggs and Big Band leader Dan Gabel open the season with America: Together in Harmony. Tickets cost forty-five to sixty dollars.

scenes.text: Free to sixty dollars covers the whole list this weekend. The same way a budget-friendly weekend lets you bump into new faces without planning much, NEAR shows you who that person was after they passed by.
